issue.title: Age lens for the memory history pager: gutter tinted by line age with labels to the introducing version

task_type_fields.proposal: Add an age lens to the pager's memory history read view. The gutter is tinted by each line's age, and labels jump to the version that introduced the line, using sase-core prose_diff line maps across the timeline.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Listed in plan:202609/memory_history.md section 18 (Non-goals and follow-ups) and recorded by launch phase sase-1dr.12 as a PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; the memory-history epic sase-1dr deliberately shipped without it, and its land agent triaged it here. (note #4)
